description: This Java class defines a Fragment named DeveloperToolsFragment for an Android application, providing developer utilities such as memory dump, tracing control, log sharing, and navigation to logcat view. It manages UI interactions, dialogs, and file sharing functionalities specific to developer tools within the app.

classes.name: DeveloperToolsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment providing developer tools such as tracing control, memory dump, log sharing, and navigation to logcat view, with UI handling and dialog management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the developer tools fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event listeners, and configures preferences.

methods.name: setupDialog
methods.description: Configures dialogs for tracing enable/disable instructions based on user actions.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Updates tracing state and sets activity title when fragment starts.

methods.name: updateTracingState
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on current tracing state.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for various developer tools actions.

methods.name: onUserClickedMemoryDump
methods.description: Initiates a memory dump process and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onUserClickedShareMemoryDump
methods.description: Shares the memory dump file via intent.

methods.name: onUserClickedFlipTracing
methods.description: Toggles tracing enabled/disabled state and updates UI.

methods.name: onUserClickedShareTracingFile
methods.description: Shares the tracing file via intent.

methods.name: onUserClickedShowLogCat
methods.description: Navigates to the LogCat view fragment.

methods.name: shareFile
methods.description: Prepares and launches an intent to share a file or text message.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Disposes of resources when the fragment is destroyed.
